rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=20, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=8, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=3, unet_c=24, residual_learning=False, rationale=iter-3: KNOB=residual_learning True->False (structural fix, NOT a knob tweak). DIAGNOSIS: iter-1 (lr2e-4)->0.3429 and iter-2 (lr1e-3)->0.2844 BOTH stuck at FBP-init (val_psnr 11.1 then 7.9 dB); raising lr 5x made it WORSE, which rules out under-training/lr. Root cause is a double-residual wiring mismatch unique to v2: SmallUNet ALREADY returns x-body(x) with a zero-init head (identity at init). With residual_learning=True, pretrain trains denoiser(fbp) against (truth-fbp) -- but denoiser(fbp) is already fbp-body(fbp), so the target asks body(fbp)~=2fbp-truth (wrong), AND at eval ItNetV2 does x_denoised=x+denoiser(x), adding the already-residual output a 2nd time -> ~2x, so the DC step can't recover -> output pinned near FBP-init. Siblings itnet(v1)=0.9729 and itnet_v3=0.9683 do NOT add the residual at eval and pretrain against TRUTH directly. Setting residual_learning=False makes v2's pretrain target=truth (train_ph) AND eval path=denoiser(x) directly -- exactly the proven v1 recipe -- while keeping SmallUNet's own internal x-body(x) residual (the good kind v1/v3 also use). HYPOTHESIS: disabling the broken double-residual lets the denoiser actually fit FBP->truth and the k=3 DC step refine it, closing most of the 0.34->~0.97 gap. Wall safe at ep8 (iter-1/2 ran ~125s).
